cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 200: 20 displayed points from 20 checkpoints (cap 30). All displayed checkpoints are exact. Recent detail covers generations 0–200: all 20 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 733.902, interval [678.211, 818.028]. Paired change versus generation 190: -19.971, 95% interval [-62.368, 24.428]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 2,560 games; 20 rated checkpoints. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 177.822.
